'''Y-G3''' was a [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] affiliated with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] that was stationed near the catacombs on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] during the [[Invasion of Ossus]].<ref name="Missing Pieces" />

==Description==
The droid's primary programming was to inform [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] forces that the contact to several Imperial [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] had been reported lost and that it was necessary to retrieve their observation datapads with highly-valuable data regarding the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] mutants.<ref name="Missing Pieces" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' {{1st}}
